grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login or HMRC Government Gateway credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity as the business owner or authorised representative registering for PAYE

grants.description: Share your business details with HMRC for employer registration
grants.purpose: HMRC needs to link your employer registration to your existing business records

grants.description: Share director or business owner personal information
grants.purpose: HMRC needs to identify who is responsible for the business and running payroll

grants.description: Provide details about your employees and payment arrangements
grants.purpose: HMRC needs to understand your payroll obligations and set up your employer account correctly

grants.description: Provide business bank account details for HMRC correspondence
grants.purpose: For HMRC to send refunds or process payments related to your PAYE obligations

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC PAYE helpline or manage through your HMRC online account
revocation.effect: Revoking consent will cancel the registration application if not yet completed. Once registered, you must formally de-register as an employer if you stop employing people.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide false information on your behalf. Agent cannot register you without your explicit confirmation of all details. Agent cannot make changes to your business structure or employment arrangements. Agent cannot access your HMRC account after registration is complete without separate authorisation.
